why.text: Updaters, sync tools and chat apps do this. So does malware checking in with its owner. A timer alone is never enough to raise an alert.
Installed software lives in /usr or /opt. Temporary and hidden folders are where downloaded payloads hide.
Most new things are harmless: a new app or a new website. But almost everything bad is new too.
Most software uses a few well-known ports. Odd ones are often games or file sharing, sometimes backdoors.
